notes: Void Terror - gains each neighbour's CURRENT attack and CURRENT health (a damaged 4/5 sitting at 2 gives +4/+2). ForEach rather than attackOf(adjacent) because attackOf reads only the FIRST match and there are two neighbours. Buffs are applied from a snapshot of both neighbours before either is destroyed, so the second neighbour's stats are still readable.
Bane of Doom - the random Demon comes from the card's printed entourage (6 ids in the pin). DamageKilled is health-based, so a Divine Shield that eats the 2 counts as a survival and no Demon arrives.
Cogmaster's Wrench - a WEAPON hosting an aura over itself, gated on owning a Mech on the battlefield. Rebuilt from zero every recalc, so the +2 comes and goes with the Mech.

Ogre Warmaul - 50% chance to attack the wrong enemy. Modelled as the equipped weapon granting FORGETFUL to your hero, which Game:ApplyForgetful already reads on the attacker. Deviation: the keyword is on the hero rather than the weapon, so a hero attack made while the Warmaul is equipped is forgetful even if its Attack came from elsewhere -- unobservable in the pinned pool, since an equipped weapon always contributes to the hero's Attack.

Imp-losion - one seeded roll, and one 1/1 Imp (GVG_045t) per point of it. `dealt` is the amount AFTER Spell Damage, so a Geomancer adds an Imp as well as a point; it is deliberately NOT the amount finally applied, so a Divine Shield that eats the hit still yields the full brood.
Neptulon - the pin gives this card NO entourage, so the Murlocs come from the collectible pool. Overload (3) is printed and applied by the engine; scripting it would double-count.
Felguard - Taunt is printed. Mana() refuses to go negative, which is what LoseManaCrystal exists for.
Unbound Elemental - PayloadHasOverload reads the PLAYED card's printed overload. HasOverload would be wrong: it reads the player's locked mana, i.e. last turn's lock.
Siege Engine - whenever YOU gain Armor. PayloadIsMine keeps the opponent's armor out of it.
Sense Demons - always yields exactly 2 cards: the shortfall is topped up with Worthless Imps (EX1_317t), whose printed flavour is the fallback (\You are out of demons!\"). Three branches because 0
Voidcaller - MoveToBoard is not a play: no mana is paid and the Demon's Battlecry does NOT fire, which is the whole point of the card.
Ancestor's Call - one minion from EACH hand, each onto its own owner's board. No Battlecries fire, as with Voidcaller.
Iron Juggernaut - the Mine is created fresh in the OPPONENT's deck, so it is theirs and they draw it. See GVG_056t for the explosion.

Burrowing Mine - TOKEN, not a collectible card; authored here because Iron Juggernaut is inert without it. DestroyInHand(self) FIRST, so the Mine has vacated the hand before the replacement card arrives and a full hand burns the replacement rather than the Mine.

Mistress of Pain - restores THAT much, so the amount comes off the event payload; `dealt` cannot reach it because a trigger runs with a fresh ctx. PayloadSourceIsSelf so it heals only for damage THIS minion dealt, however it dealt it -- attacking, or being attacked back.

Edwin VanCleef - combo only; with no earlier card the amount is 0 and he is a plain 2/2. PlayCard increments cardsPlayedThisTurn BEFORE the combo body runs, which is why the amount subtracts Edwin himself.
Brawl - BOTH sides, survivor drawn from the shared seeded stream. REQ_MINIMUM_TOTAL_MINIONS=2 is printed, so Targeting refuses the cast below two minions.

Bouncing Blade - RepeatUntil runs the body FIRST and then tests, which is the do-while the card wants: it always deals at least one point. Both sides are in the pool. The $1 carries the spell-damage sigil, so each bounce is scaled.

Trade Prince Gallywix - the Coin it hands over is GVG_028t Gallywix's Coin, NOT GAME_005; its printed text is literally '(Won't trigger Gallywix.)', and without that guard the opponent playing it re-triggers this into an unbounded coin engine. CARD_PLAYED + PayloadIsSpell rather than SPELL_CAST because a Secret IS a SPELL in printed data and the card says 'casts a spell'; the engine does not raise SPELL_CAST for secrets. The guard is an inline If because parse_cond tests the `not ` prefix BEFORE splitting on ` and `, so `not A and not B` would parse as `not (A and not B)`.
Gallywix's Coin - TOKEN. Same body as The Coin: one crystal THIS TURN ONLY, so temporary rather than a permanent gain. It is a separate card id from GAME_005 purely so Gallywix can refuse to copy it.
